text: Based on the evidence, the property appears legally compliant regarding forests for the period 2021–2025. No tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger were detected within the asset boundary during this time. However, minor changes (under 0.5 ha) or those at the edges of the property may not have been captured due to the resolution limits of the satellite data (30-meter pixels). The property had no forest cover in 2020 (per JRC data), and while there were small historical losses before the baseline (e.g., 67.7 ha in 2020), these occurred outside the compliance period. The evidence does not confirm full compliance with specific regulations (e.g., EUDR), but it shows no detectable deforestation during the evaluated interval.
